Evidence:
[1] It is made of rice flour, semolina and maida flour which are mixed with sliced onion, curry leaves, grated coconut and asafoetida.
[2] Some cooking bananas are also referred to as green bananas or plantains.
[3] Sukiyan (or sukhiyan) is a fritter food made by pulses with jaggery and maida flour.
[4] Pazham pori is a fritter food made by pulses with ripened banana or plantain and maida flour.
